answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the forge log reveals the live set and the trellis audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 601 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 114 aliases alive as a result means 114 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the summit quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
